rows.label: Payment Gateway Settings
rows.description:
#### Payment Gateway

* The online service provider that facilitates secure processing of customer payments.
* Choose from a drop-down list with the following options: **PhonePe**, **Razorpay**, or **Cashfree**.
* If you require integration with a new **Payment Gateway** not listed, email us at [skpintu93@gmail.com](mailto:skpintu93@gmail.com) (this service will incur additional charges).
* Follow the respective gateway’s documentation for guidance on generating these credentials.
